segments.text: Hello, and welcome to Module 2 of RSO Training.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到注册学生社团（RSO）培训的第 2 单元。

segments.text: In this module, we'll be discussing key policies for your RSO.
segments.zh: 在本单元中，我们将讨论与你们社团相关的主要政策。

segments.text: To start out, let's discuss hazing.
segments.zh: 首先，我们来讨论欺凌性入会仪式（hazing）。

segments.text: The University of Chicago prohibits hazing.
segments.zh: 芝加哥大学禁止 hazing。

segments.text: A person commits hazing when he or she knowingly requires a student or other person at the
segments.zh: 如果一个人明知故犯地要求本校的学生或其他人

segments.text: university to perform any act, on or off university property, for the purpose of induction,
segments.zh: 在校内或校外做出任何行为，目的是为了加入、

segments.text: admission, or membership into any group, team, organization, or society that is connected
segments.zh: 被接纳进入或成为与本校有关联的任何团体、队伍、组织或社团的成员，

segments.text: to the university.
segments.zh: 就构成了 hazing。

segments.text: This act is not sanctioned or authorized by the university and results in harm to any person
segments.zh: 这种行为未经大学认可或授权，并且对任何人造成伤害，

segments.text: or could reasonably be foreseen to result in such harm.
segments.zh: 或者可以合理预见会造成这种伤害。

segments.text: A person's willingness to participate in an act of hazing does not justify or excuse the
segments.zh: 一个人自愿参与 hazing 行为，并不能使该行为正当化或得到开脱，

segments.text: act or fall outside of this policy.
segments.zh: 也不会使其不受本政策约束。

segments.text: Some examples of hazing include the creation of physical or mental exhaustion or fatigue,
segments.zh: hazing 的一些例子包括：造成身体或精神上的疲惫或劳累、

segments.text: course consumption of alcohol or other intoxicants, physical and mental shocks, paddling, physically
segments.zh: 强迫饮用酒精或其他致醉物、身体和精神上的冲击、用板子打人、身体上

segments.text: or psychologically dangerous or risky activities, coercive, degrading, or humiliating games
segments.zh: 或心理上危险或有风险的活动、带有强迫性、贬低性或羞辱性的游戏

segments.text: and activities, appropriation of public or private property, physical harm, and pressuring
segments.zh: 和活动、侵占公共或私人财产、身体伤害，以及施压

segments.text: or coercing any person to participate in activities that are inconsistent with the
segments.zh: 或强迫任何人参加与

segments.text: university's community standards, policies, or applicable law.
segments.zh: 大学的社区准则、政策或适用法律不一致的活动。

segments.text: This list is intended to be illustrative and not all inclusive.
segments.zh: 这份清单只是举例说明，并非全部。

segments.text: Any student or group that commits hazing will be subject to discipline under college housing
segments.zh: 任何实施 hazing 的学生或团体，都将视情况根据学院住宿纪律

segments.text: discipline or the germane student disciplinary system is appropriate.
segments.zh: 或相关的学生纪律处分制度受到处分。

segments.text: A staff member, post-doctoral researcher, academic employee, or anyone with a visiting
segments.zh: 教职工、博士后研究人员、学术雇员或任何持访问职位的人

segments.text: appointment who commits hazing will be subject to discipline under the applicable disciplinary
segments.zh: 如实施 hazing，将根据适用的纪律处分

segments.text: processes.
segments.zh: 程序受到处分。

segments.text: In addition, hazing is a crime under Illinois law.
segments.zh: 此外，根据伊利诺伊州法律，hazing 属于犯罪。

segments.text: The state's attorney may bring criminal charges against any person responsible for hazing.
segments.zh: 州检察官可以对任何应对 hazing 负责的人提起刑事指控。

segments.text: Any person with knowledge of hazing is expected to communicate promptly with the Office of
segments.zh: 任何知晓 hazing 行为的人都应及时与

segments.text: the Vice President of Campus Life, the Office of the Provost, the University of Chicago
segments.zh: 分管校园生活的副校长办公室、教务长办公室、芝加哥大学

segments.text: Police Department, or University Human Resources.
segments.zh: 警察局或大学人力资源部门联系。

segments.text: Reports may also be made anonymously using the university's whistleblower hotline, the
segments.zh: 也可以通过学校的举报热线匿名举报，

segments.text: number provided below.
segments.zh: 号码见下方。

segments.text: Next, we will discuss protest and demonstration on campus.
segments.zh: 接下来，我们将讨论校园内的抗议和示威活动。

segments.text: The primary function of a university is to discover and disseminate knowledge by means
segments.zh: 大学的首要职能是通过研究和教学

segments.text: of research and teaching.
segments.zh: 来发现和传播知识。

segments.text: To fulfill this function, a free interchange of ideas is necessary not only within the
segments.zh: 为了履行这一职能，思想的自由交流是必要的，不仅在

segments.text: university, but also with the larger society.
segments.zh: 大学内部，也包括与更广泛的社会之间。

segments.text: At the University of Chicago, freedom of expression is vital to our shared goal of the pursuit
segments.zh: 在芝加哥大学，言论自由对于我们追求知识这一共同目标

segments.text: of knowledge.
segments.zh: 至关重要。

segments.text: Such freedom comes with the responsibility to welcome and promote this freedom for all.
segments.zh: 这种自由伴随着一种责任，即为所有人欢迎并促进这种自由。

segments.text: The right of freedom of expression at the university includes peaceful protests and orderly
segments.zh: 在大学里，言论自由的权利包括和平抗议和有秩序的

segments.text: demonstrations.
segments.zh: 示威。

segments.text: At the same time, the university has long recognized that the right to protest and demonstrate
segments.zh: 与此同时，大学一直认为，抗议和示威的权利

segments.text: does not include the right to engage in conduct that disrupts the university's operations
segments.zh: 并不包括从事扰乱大学运作

segments.text: or endangers the safety of others.
segments.zh: 或危及他人安全的行为的权利。

segments.text: Conduct of members of the university disruptive of the operations of the university, including
segments.zh: 大学成员扰乱大学运作的行为，包括

segments.text: interference with instruction, research, administrative operations, freedom of association, and meetings
segments.zh: 干扰教学、研究、行政运作、结社自由和会议，

segments.text: is prohibited in subject to disciplinary action.
segments.zh: 都是被禁止的，并将受到纪律处分。

segments.text: The Dean on Call will work actively to preserve an environment of spirited and open discourse
segments.zh: 值班院长（Dean on Call）将积极努力维护一个充满活力、开放的讨论

segments.text: and debate, allowing for the opportunity to have all participants contribute to intellectual
segments.zh: 和辩论环境，让所有参与者都有机会为思想

segments.text: exchanges and full participation in the event.
segments.zh: 交流作出贡献，并充分参与活动。

segments.text: The Dean on Call is not meant to be there in a disciplinary way, they are meant to
segments.zh: 值班院长在场并不是为了处分谁，而是为了

segments.text: support you.
segments.zh: 支持你们。

segments.text: A few notes on noise level and building occupancy in your protestor demonstration.
segments.zh: 关于抗议或示威中的噪音水平和建筑物容纳人数，有几点说明。

segments.text: All protests and demonstrations held outdoors are subject to the same guidelines outlined
segments.zh: 所有在户外举行的抗议和示威，都适用

segments.text: in the Outdoor Events on Campus Policy, which is linked in the dig deeper section
segments.zh: 《校园户外活动政策》中规定的同样准则，该政策的链接在本单元的

segments.text: of this module.
segments.zh: “深入了解”部分。

segments.text: For a protestor demonstration, attention must be paid to the occupancy limits and general
segments.zh: 对于抗议或示威，必须注意所使用场地的容纳人数限制

segments.text: safety of the university community in the space being used.
segments.zh: 以及大学社区的总体安全。

segments.text: Please see Building Occupancy Limits and Access linked in the dig deeper section of
segments.zh: 请参阅本单元“深入了解”部分链接的

segments.text: this module.
segments.zh: 《建筑物容纳人数限制与出入》。

segments.text: Placards, banners, and signs generally are allowed but may not be dangerous for others
segments.zh: 标语牌、横幅和标志一般是允许的，但不得对他人造成危险，

segments.text: or impede the participation of others in the life of the university.
segments.zh: 也不得妨碍他人参与大学生活。

segments.text: The use of placards, banners, and signs are deemed to be dangerous or impede the participation
segments.zh: 如果标语牌、横幅和标志的使用被认为有危险或妨碍了

segments.text: of others.
segments.zh: 他人的参与，

segments.text: University officials will require the individuals carrying the placards, banners, or signs
segments.zh: 大学工作人员将要求携带标语牌、横幅或标志的人

segments.text: to move to a different location or remove their materials.
segments.zh: 移到其他地方或撤走他们的物品。

segments.text: Adherence to building closures is expected of people participating in a protestor demonstration
segments.zh: 在大学建筑物内参加抗议或示威的人应当遵守建筑物关闭时间，

segments.text: within a university building, and university officials will require that protesters or
segments.zh: 大学工作人员将要求抗议者或

segments.text: demonstrators leave at the time of building closure.
segments.zh: 示威者在建筑物关闭时离开。

segments.text: To further the effectiveness of your protestor demonstration, organizations and other groups
segments.zh: 为了让你们的抗议或示威更有成效，组织抗议或示威的社团和其他

segments.text: of students organizing a protestor demonstration must make the appropriate arrangements with
segments.zh: 学生团体必须与

segments.text: the staff for the Center for Leadership and Involvement and or the appropriate RSO
segments.zh: 领导力与参与中心（Center for Leadership and Involvement）的工作人员和／或相关的 RSO

segments.text: advisor.
segments.zh: 指导老师做好适当安排。

segments.text: The protest location must be approved in advance by the Center for Leadership and Involvement
segments.zh: 抗议地点必须事先获得领导力与参与中心的批准，

segments.text: and intended movements to other areas of campus or into buildings and offices must be expressed
segments.zh: 打算移动到校园其他区域或进入建筑物和办公室的，必须在

segments.text: in the initial protest request and are explicitly approved in advance.
segments.zh: 最初的抗议申请中写明，并事先获得明确批准。

segments.text: This is to help you maintain a successful demonstration.
segments.zh: 这是为了帮助你们顺利地开展示威。

segments.text: Like all other events or activities at the university, a request to hold a protestor
segments.zh: 和大学里的所有其他活动一样，举行抗议或

segments.text: demonstration should be submitted no later than 48 hours before the start of the event
segments.zh: 示威的申请应在活动开始前至少 48 小时提交，

segments.text: and must be approved by the Center for Leadership and Involvement and or the appropriate
segments.zh: 并且必须获得领导力与参与中心和／或相关的

segments.text: RSO advisor.
segments.zh: RSO 指导老师的批准。

segments.text: The RSO advisor together with the Dean on call will be engaged with the student protesters
segments.zh: RSO 指导老师将和值班院长一起，在活动期间与参与抗议

segments.text: and demonstrators during the event to help assure the event is effective, ensure participant
segments.zh: 和示威的学生保持接触，帮助确保活动有成效、确保参与者的

segments.text: safety and does not disrupt the normal functioning of the university.
segments.zh: 安全，并且不扰乱大学的正常运作。

segments.text: Students are also asked to make appropriate arrangements to acquire city permits for
segments.zh: 对于在大学附近的城市人行道和街道上举行的活动，

segments.text: events occurring on city sidewalks and streets adjacent to the university and must adhere
segments.zh: 学生还需做好适当安排，申请城市许可证，并必须遵守

segments.text: to city ordinances and applicable state and federal laws.
segments.zh: 城市条例以及适用的州法律和联邦法律。

segments.text: Students and demonstrations are normally permitted until or unless the university officials
segments.zh: 学生和示威通常是被允许的，直到或除非大学工作人员

segments.text: determine that university operations have been compromised and or the rights of others have
segments.zh: 认定大学的运作已经受到损害，和／或他人的权利

segments.text: been significantly infringed upon.
segments.zh: 受到了严重侵犯。

segments.text: Interference with instruction and research are viewed as particularly disrupted to the
segments.zh: 对教学和研究的干扰被视为对大学

segments.text: university.
segments.zh: 尤其具有扰乱性。

segments.text: Application of this policy does not preclude the application of other university policies
segments.zh: 本政策的适用并不排除根据具体情况

segments.text: or regulations as may be warranted by a given situation.
segments.zh: 适用大学的其他政策或规章。

segments.text: This might include the authority to direct university ID policy, use of the dean on call
segments.zh: 这可能包括执行大学证件政策的权力、使用值班院长

segments.text: program and university disciplinary systems.
segments.zh: 项目以及大学的纪律处分制度。

segments.text: Furthermore, a protestor demonstration that significantly disrupts the operations of the
segments.zh: 此外，严重扰乱大学运作

segments.text: university or fails to adhere to building closures may lead to arrest and prosecution
segments.zh: 或不遵守建筑物关闭时间的抗议或示威，可能会导致

segments.text: for violations of city of Chicago ordinances or state and federal statutes.
segments.zh: 因违反芝加哥市条例或州法律和联邦法规而被逮捕和起诉。

segments.text: A protest demonstration or event on campus may invite another form of protest.
segments.zh: 校园里的一场抗议示威或活动可能会引发另一种形式的抗议。

segments.text: When these occasions arise, the expression of all parties is important.
segments.zh: 出现这种情况时，各方的表达都很重要。

segments.text: Please note that a separate protest area may be designated by campus and student life for
segments.zh: 请注意，校园与学生生活部门可能会为

segments.text: those persons with views that differ from the views held by the event organizers.
segments.zh: 持有与活动组织者不同观点的人划定一个单独的抗议区域。

segments.text: In order to ensure the safety of all participants, the university police department may require
segments.zh: 为了确保所有参与者的安全，大学警察局可能会要求

segments.text: the attendance of one or more officers.
segments.zh: 一名或多名警员到场。

segments.text: All people participating in protests and demonstrations are expected to provide a form of university
segments.zh: 所有参加抗议和示威的人都应在大学工作人员要求时，

segments.text: issued or government issued identification upon request from a university official.
segments.zh: 出示大学签发或政府签发的身份证件。

segments.text: For full explanations of these policies, please visit the links in the dig deeper section
segments.zh: 关于这些政策的完整说明，请访问本单元

segments.text: of this module.
segments.zh: “深入了解”部分中的链接。

segments.text: Let's transition and talk about the alcohol policy.
segments.zh: 我们换个话题，谈谈酒精政策。

segments.text: The university allows moderate consumption and or possession of alcohol on university
segments.zh: 大学允许在经批准的活动中，由法律允许饮用或提供酒精的人

segments.text: premises at approved functions by those legally permitted to consume or distribute alcohol.
segments.zh: 在大学场所内适量饮用和／或持有酒精。

segments.text: Illinois law prohibits the consumption or possession of alcohol by persons under the
segments.zh: 伊利诺伊州法律禁止 21 岁以下的人饮用或持有酒精，

segments.text: age of 21 and the supplying of alcohol to any person under the age of 21.
segments.zh: 也禁止向任何 21 岁以下的人提供酒精。

segments.text: To request permission to serve alcohol at an event, please read and sign the guidelines
segments.zh: 要申请在活动中提供酒精，请阅读并签署

segments.text: in the event alcohol approval request form available in the dig deeper section of this
segments.zh: 活动酒精审批申请表中的准则，该表格可在本单元“深入了解”部分

segments.text: module.
segments.zh: 找到。

segments.text: Note that this form must be submitted to your RSO advisor for review and approval at least
segments.zh: 请注意，这份表格必须在活动前至少两周提交给你们的 RSO 指导老师

segments.text: two weeks prior to the event.
segments.zh: 进行审核和批准。

segments.text: Person serving alcohol must be at least 21 years old and have completed UCARE training,
segments.zh: 提供酒精的人必须年满 21 岁，并完成 UCARE 培训，

segments.text: which is linked in the dig deeper section of this module.
segments.zh: 培训链接在本单元的“深入了解”部分。

segments.text: Amounts of alcohol to be served will be determined by the Center for Leadership and Involvement.
segments.zh: 提供的酒精数量将由领导力与参与中心决定。

segments.text: This is determined by the length of the event and the number of guests.
segments.zh: 这根据活动时长和来宾人数来决定。

segments.text: Groups must designate one student and one full-time staff or faculty member to be present
segments.zh: 各团体必须指定一名学生和一名全职职员或教师

segments.text: for the entire event.
segments.zh: 全程在场。

segments.text: Only beer and wine may be served.
segments.zh: 只能提供啤酒和葡萄酒。

segments.text: No hard alcohol.
segments.zh: 不能提供烈酒。

segments.text: For events where individuals under 21 may be present, university staff or faculty may
segments.zh: 对于可能有 21 岁以下人员在场的活动，可能需要由大学职员或教师

segments.text: have to check identification and serve alcohol.
segments.zh: 查验身份证件并提供酒精。

segments.text: Students will be allowed a maximum of three reasonably sized drinks.
segments.zh: 每名学生最多可以喝三杯分量合理的酒。

segments.text: Fewer may be allowed based on the length of the event.
segments.zh: 根据活动时长，允许的数量可能更少。

segments.text: Appropriate precautions must be taken to ensure that event participants under 21 do not have
segments.zh: 必须采取适当的预防措施，确保 21 岁以下的活动参与者

segments.text: access to alcoholic beverages.
segments.zh: 接触不到含酒精饮料。

segments.text: Sufficient amounts of non-alcoholic beverages must be available and adequate quantities of
segments.zh: 必须提供足够的无酒精饮料，还必须提供足量的

segments.text: non-salty food must also be available.
segments.zh: 不咸的食物。

segments.text: Consumption will be limited to an improved area only, and individuals may not bring their
segments.zh: 饮酒仅限于经批准的区域，个人不得自带

segments.text: own alcohol to the event.
segments.zh: 酒精到活动中。

segments.text: There may be no reference to the availability of alcohol in any publicity for your event,
segments.zh: 活动的任何宣传中都不得提及有酒精供应，

segments.text: and no alcohol may be served during the last half hour of an event.
segments.zh: 并且在活动的最后半小时内不得提供酒精。

segments.text: Finally, let's discuss the RSO Travel Policy.
segments.zh: 最后，我们来讨论 RSO 出行政策。

segments.text: RSO travel must be consistent with the organization's mission statement and must not create undue
segments.zh: RSO 出行必须符合社团的宗旨，并且不得对

segments.text: interference with academic responsibilities.
segments.zh: 学业责任造成不当干扰。

segments.text: Remember, you are a student first.
segments.zh: 记住，你首先是一名学生。

segments.text: RSOs that are traveling must complete and submit the travel registration form via blueprint
segments.zh: 要出行的 RSO 必须在预定行程前至少 10 个工作日

segments.text: no later than 10 business days before the scheduled trip.
segments.zh: 通过 Blueprint 填写并提交出行登记表。

segments.text: The form will be reviewed by your RSO advisor, who may have follow-up questions to ask or
segments.zh: 这份表格将由你们的 RSO 指导老师审核，他可能会有后续问题要问，

segments.text: may require other information from you.
segments.zh: 或者可能要求你们提供其他信息。

segments.text: The travel form must be approved by your advisor before travel can go forward.
segments.zh: 出行表格必须获得指导老师批准，出行才能进行。

segments.text: When students are driving for their RSO, whether in personal, rental, or university vehicles,
segments.zh: 学生为 RSO 开车时，无论是私家车、租赁车辆还是大学车辆，

segments.text: all drivers must comply with the university's vehicle policy, which follows.
segments.zh: 所有司机都必须遵守下面介绍的大学车辆政策。

segments.text: RSOs must, as a part of the travel registration process, supply the Center for Leadership
segments.zh: 作为出行登记程序的一部分，RSO 必须向领导力与参与中心

segments.text: and Involvement with the names, CNET ideas, and cell phone numbers of all students traveling.
segments.zh: 提供所有出行学生的姓名、CNetID 和手机号码。

segments.text: Note that any trip taken without prior submission and approval and accurate registration
segments.zh: 请注意，任何未事先提交并获得批准、没有准确的登记

segments.text: and or driver forms or other violations of this policy may result in individual and or
segments.zh: 和／或司机表格的出行，或其他违反本政策的行为，都可能导致个人和／或

segments.text: RSO discipline and RSOs will not be reimbursed for travel expenses.
segments.zh: RSO 受到处分，而且 RSO 的出行费用将不予报销。

segments.text: We've mentioned the vehicle policy.
segments.zh: 我们已经提到了车辆政策。

segments.text: Let's take a closer look.
segments.zh: 我们来仔细看一下。

segments.text: To drive for your RSO, you must meet the following driver qualifications.
segments.zh: 要为你们的 RSO 开车，你必须满足以下司机资格。

segments.text: You must be a minimum of 18 years of age or meet rental car company minimum age requirements
segments.zh: 你必须年满 18 岁，或者如果你租车，

segments.text: if you are renting a vehicle.
segments.zh: 必须满足租车公司的最低年龄要求。

segments.text: You need to possess a valid United States driver's license for at least two years and
segments.zh: 你需要持有有效的美国驾照至少两年，并且

segments.text: have more than 2,000 miles of driving experience.
segments.zh: 有超过 2,000 英里的驾驶经验。

segments.text: Furthermore, you may not have received any moving violations, convictions, or court-ordered
segments.zh: 此外，你不得有任何行车违章、定罪或法院下令的

segments.text: supervision.
segments.zh: 监管记录。

segments.text: You must apply on an annual basis for driver approval.
segments.zh: 你必须每年申请一次司机资格审批。

segments.text: To be approved to drive, you should submit the following to the Student Activity Center
segments.zh: 要获得开车资格，你应在出行前至少两周

segments.text: or to your advisor at least two weeks before your trip.
segments.zh: 向学生活动中心或你的指导老师提交以下材料。

segments.text: If you're driving a rental vehicle, you must submit the Vehicle Use Acknowledgement Form,
segments.zh: 如果你开的是租赁车辆，你必须提交车辆使用确认书、

segments.text: the Student Vehicle Use Authorization Form, and a front and back copy of your valid United
segments.zh: 学生车辆使用授权表，以及你有效美国驾照的

segments.text: States driver's license.
segments.zh: 正反面复印件。

segments.text: If you're driving a personal vehicle, you must submit the Vehicle Use Acknowledgement
segments.zh: 如果你开的是私家车，你必须提交车辆使用确认书、

segments.text: Form, the Student Vehicle Use Authorization Form, Student Personal Vehicle Use and Agreement
segments.zh: 学生车辆使用授权表、学生私家车使用协议

segments.text: Form, a Vehicle Inspection Form, Proof of Insurance, and a front and back copy of your
segments.zh: 表、车辆检查表、保险证明，以及你

segments.text: valid United States driver's license.
segments.zh: 有效美国驾照的正反面复印件。

segments.text: Links to all of these forms are available in the Dig deeper section of this module.
segments.zh: 所有这些表格的链接都在本单元的“深入了解”部分。

segments.text: Any traffic citation or parking ticket issued is the responsibility of the driver.
segments.zh: 开出的任何交通罚单或停车罚单都由司机负责。

segments.text: The university provides no legal or financial assistance to students who receive such citations.
segments.zh: 对于收到此类罚单的学生，大学不提供任何法律或经济援助。

segments.text: If the university has served with the citation because of the use of the vehicle, the student
segments.zh: 如果大学因车辆的使用而收到罚单，学生

segments.text: organizations sell and reimburse the university for its costs.
segments.zh: 社团应向大学偿付相关费用。

segments.text: When renting a vehicle, you do not need to purchase the rental company's insurance policy
segments.zh: 租车时，你不需要购买租车公司的保险，

segments.text: and it is not reimbursable.
segments.zh: 而且这笔费用不予报销。

segments.text: The rental vehicle will be covered under the university's insurance policy as long as all
segments.zh: 只要所有相关文书都已填写完毕，并且司机已获批准，

segments.text: appropriate paperwork is completed and the driver has been approved.
segments.zh: 租赁车辆就会在大学的保险范围内。

segments.text: We require you to follow driving rules and regulations while traveling for your RSO.
segments.zh: 在为你们的 RSO 出行时，我们要求你们遵守驾驶规则和规定。

segments.text: Obey all traffic and motor vehicle laws, drive responsibly, assure that all vehicle
segments.zh: 遵守所有交通和机动车法律，负责任地驾驶，确保所有车内

segments.text: occupants wear seat belts at all times, and drivers shall not pick up or transport
segments.zh: 乘员始终系好安全带，而且司机不得搭载或运送

segments.text: any person who is not traveling on university-related matters approved by the Center for Leadership
segments.zh: 任何不是为经领导力

segments.text: and Evolvement.
segments.zh: 与参与中心批准的大学相关事务出行的人。

segments.text: You should have your valid license in your possession at all times, be alcohol and drug-free.
segments.zh: 你应随时携带有效驾照，不得饮酒或吸毒。

segments.text: When in doubt, do not operate the vehicle in hazardous driving conditions, including
segments.zh: 有疑问时，不要在危险的驾驶条件下开车，包括

segments.text: heavy rain, fog, snow, or ice.
segments.zh: 大雨、大雾、下雪或结冰。

segments.text: Do not operate the vehicle if engine, brakes, lights, or steering are not operating properly.
segments.zh: 如果发动机、刹车、车灯或转向系统工作不正常，不要开车。

segments.text: Do not adjust the radio, tape, CD player, iPods, or phones while driving.
segments.zh: 开车时不要调收音机、磁带机、CD 机、iPod 或手机。

segments.text: These may be played as long as the sound level is low enough to permit the driver to hear
segments.zh: 这些可以播放，只要音量低到司机能听见

segments.text: a car horn.
segments.zh: 汽车喇叭声即可。

segments.text: Also, do not eat, drink, smoke, or use cell phones, including texting while driving.
segments.zh: 另外，开车时不要吃东西、喝东西、抽烟或使用手机，包括发短信。

segments.text: For trips over 250 miles, no driver may operate a vehicle for more than three consecutive
segments.zh: 对于超过 250 英里的行程，任何司机连续驾驶不得超过三个

segments.text: hours more than six hours in one day.
segments.zh: 小时，一天不得超过六个小时。

segments.text: No student may ride in a vehicle for more than 16 hours within a 24-hour period on university-related
segments.zh: 任何学生因大学相关事务在 24 小时内乘车

segments.text: matters.
segments.zh: 不得超过 16 小时。

segments.text: At least one person must be awake and in the seat next to the driver at all times,
segments.zh: 副驾驶座上必须始终至少有一个人保持清醒，

segments.text: and no driving is allowed between the hours of midnight and 6 a.m.
segments.zh: 而且午夜到早上 6 点之间不允许开车。

segments.text: In the event of an accident or emergency, please immediately report the accident to the
segments.zh: 如果发生事故或紧急情况，请立即向

segments.text: Office of Risk Management as well as the approving office of the trip.
segments.zh: 风险管理办公室以及批准这次出行的部门报告事故。

segments.text: In the event of emergency, and you need immediate assistance, call the local authorities and
segments.zh: 如果发生紧急情况，需要立即求助，请联系当地有关部门，

segments.text: dial 911.
All traffic citations must be reported to the approving office, in this case the Center
segments.zh: 所有交通罚单都必须报告给批准部门，在这里就是

segments.text: for Leadership and Involvement.
segments.zh: 领导力与参与中心。

segments.text: In the event of an accident or emergency, remain calm and courteous, prevent additional
segments.zh: 如果发生事故或紧急情况，要保持冷静和礼貌，尽快安全地驶离道路、

segments.text: damage by getting safely off the road and turning off ignition as soon as possible.
segments.zh: 关闭点火开关，以防止进一步的损害。

segments.text: Record the facts and details, including the names and addresses of drivers involved
segments.zh: 记录事实和细节，包括相关司机的姓名和地址，

segments.text: and vehicle descriptions and plates.
segments.zh: 以及车辆描述和车牌号。

segments.text: Give your information to other drivers and to the authorities.
segments.zh: 把你的信息提供给其他司机和有关部门。

segments.text: Do not express an opinion to who is at fault.
segments.zh: 不要对谁有过错发表意见。

segments.text: Do not talk about the accident to anyone except for the police, the owner of the other
segments.zh: 除了警察、另一辆车的车主、

segments.text: vehicle, the rental car company, your RSO advisor, and the Office of Risk Management.
segments.zh: 租车公司、你的 RSO 指导老师和风险管理办公室之外，不要和任何人谈论这起事故。

segments.text: We wanted to take a moment to discuss the policy on harassment, discrimination, and
segments.zh: 我们想花一点时间讨论一下关于骚扰、歧视和

segments.text: sexual misconduct.
segments.zh: 性不当行为的政策。

segments.text: We will be providing a full and in-depth training on this topic at RSO Training in
segments.zh: 我们将在十月的 RSO 培训中就这个主题进行全面、深入的

segments.text: October.
segments.zh: 培训。

segments.text: However, we did want to cover some key passages and resources for you.
segments.zh: 不过，我们还是想为大家介绍一些关键条文和资源。

segments.text: The University is committed to an environment free from discrimination, sexual harassment,
segments.zh: 大学致力于营造一个没有歧视、性骚扰、

segments.text: and other unlawful forms of harassment, sexual misconduct, sexual assault, domestic violence,
segments.zh: 其他非法形式的骚扰、性不当行为、性侵犯、家庭暴力、

segments.text: dating violence, and stalking.
segments.zh: 约会暴力和跟踪的环境。

segments.text: The University does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual
segments.zh: 大学不因种族、肤色、宗教、性别、性

segments.text: orientation, gender identity, national or ethnic origin, age, status as an individual
segments.zh: 取向、性别认同、国籍或族裔、年龄、残障人士身份、

segments.text: with a disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or other protected classes
segments.zh: 受保护的退伍军人身份、遗传信息或法律规定的

segments.text: as required by law.
segments.zh: 其他受保护类别而歧视任何人。

segments.text: There are a number of key resources available to University community members should you
segments.zh: 如果你在 UChicago 遭受任何形式的骚扰，大学社区成员

segments.text: experience harassment of any kind at UChicago.
segments.zh: 可以使用许多重要的资源。

segments.text: The Dean on Call and the Sexual Assault Dean on Call may be reached by dialing 773-834-HELP.
segments.zh: 拨打 773-834-HELP 可以联系值班院长和性侵犯事务值班院长。

segments.text: Alternatively, you may reach the Dean on Call or Sexual Assault Dean on Call by contacting
segments.zh: 或者，你也可以通过联系芝加哥大学警察局，

segments.text: the University of Chicago Police Department at 773-702-8181 or by dialing 123 from a
campus phone.
segments.zh: 联系值班院长或性侵犯事务值班院长。

segments.text: Some other key resources include student health service, student counseling service, and resources
segments.zh: 其他一些重要资源包括学生健康服务、学生心理咨询服务，以及

segments.text: for sexual violence prevention.
segments.zh: 预防性暴力的资源。

segments.text: For a full list of resources and background on this policy, please visit umatter.uchicago.edu.
segments.zh: 关于资源的完整列表和本政策的背景，请访问 umatter.uchicago.edu。

segments.text: All of these phone numbers and the link to the umatter site are provided in the dig
segments.zh: 所有这些电话号码以及 umatter 网站的链接都在本单元的

segments.text: deeper section of this module.
segments.zh: “深入了解”部分提供。

segments.text: You have now reached the end of training module 2.
segments.zh: 现在你已经学完了第 2 单元的培训。

segments.text: Please complete the quiz in the think section and then move on to module 3, which is linked
segments.zh: 请完成“思考”部分的测验，然后进入第 3 单元，其链接

segments.text: in the dig deeper section of this module.
segments.zh: 在本单元的“深入了解”部分。
